Priority: urgent

Fix the root cause of a repeated failure: Athena treats a stage budget cap as a hard failure, not a resumable stop. A budget stop, a usage-lim

The same cause has produced failures in more than one job. Find the cause where it originates and fix it there, so the whole class is prevented; do not work around one instance.

Failure class: producer-hits-budget-cap-job-ends-failed-no-hold-or-partial-result (20261029-002738-mh17)
Cause: Athena treats a stage budget cap as a hard failure, not a resumable stop. A budget stop, a usage-limit reply and a disk stop are all external limits, not defects in the work. Only disk stops have started to get a resume path, so the others ...
Seen 2 time(s) in 2 jobs. The introspections that record it:
Introspection 20261029-002727-53n9 (job 20261028-235200-sssc); prevention it proposed: Classify every producer stop caused by an external or resource limit (budget cap, usage limit, low disk, expired credential) as a hold or resumable state, not a failure. On such a stop, keep the producer's working tree and a progress note. ...
Introspection 20261031-095208-bksh (job 20261030-185530-b5hm); prevention it proposed: When a planning or producer stage stops on its budget cap, Athena should save the partial plan or work, put the job on hold with a clear "budget cap reached" reason instead of failed, and offer a resume that continues from the saved state w...

Acceptance:
- The root cause is named in the change description and fixed where it originates, not at one instance
- A test fails without the change and passes with it, for the cause and not only for one job
- fmt, clippy and test pass
